summary: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corp (QRED), a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to its June 9, 2026 merger agreement with Robseek Intelligence Inc.; the SPAC is the target being combined into Purchaser. The amendment clarifies that each right receives one-fourth of a Purchaser ordinary share, collapses the dual-class structure into a single one-vote class, restates the allocation schedule at 100,000,000 closing payment shares, and sets lock-ups running until the earlier of 180 days post-close or a $12.50 price condition after 90 days. Watch redemption levels and closing timing.
